description:
Start a chat completion as an async background job. Returns a job_id immediately without waiting for the model to respond. Use `get_chat_completion_status` to poll for results. Designed for reasoning models or any request that may exceed MCP timeout limits (~60s). Accepts the full chat_completion parameter set: provider routing, model suffixes, web search (`online`, `web_blocked_domains`), structured output (`response_format`), multi-model fusion (`fusion`), subagent delegation (`subagent`), response healing, reasoning effort control, and all sampling controls (`temperature`, `top_p`, `stop`, `frequency_penalty`, `presence_penalty`, `logprobs`, `seed`).

Use when:
- Using a reasoning model that may take >60 seconds (DeepSeek R1, Claude Opus, etc.)
- Connected through a remote MCP bridge with short timeouts
- You want to fire-and-forget a completion and check back later
- You need async web search, fusion, or structured output on a slow model

Do NOT use when:
- Fast models that respond within seconds → use chat_completion directly
- You want the result returned in the same MCP response → use chat_completion (async adds polling overhead)
- You need a structured yes/no, choice, or score decision with calibrated probabilities → use decide
- You need vector embeddings for RAG or semantic search → use embed_text
- You need to rerank documents by relevance to a query → use rerank_documents
- Messages array is empty

Good examples:
- `{ "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Prove the Riemann hypothesis" }], "model": "deepseek/r1" }`
- `{ "messages": [...], "include_reasoning": true }` for long chain-of-thought
- `{ "messages": [...], "model": "openai/o3", "online": true, "reasoning_effort": "high" }` async web-grounded reasoning
- `{ "messages": [...], "fusion": true, "response_format": { "type": "json_object" } }` async multi-model JSON

Bad examples:
- `{ "messages": [] }` → INVALID_INPUT
- Using this for simple "hello world" prompts (unnecessary overhead)

Fails when:
- INVALID_INPUT: empty messages array
- Job may fail in background if model errors or credits exhausted

Works with: get_chat_completion_status, chat_completion.

cache.description: Enable OpenRouter response caching via `X-OpenRouter-Cache: true`. Server default: `OPENROUTER_CACHE_RESPONSES=1`.

cache_clear.description: Bust the cache entry for this exact request.

cache_ttl.description: Cache TTL as integer seconds (1–86400) or a duration string such as "30s", "5m", or "1h". Sent upstream as seconds.

frequency_penalty.description: Penalize tokens by existing frequency. Between -2 and 2.

logprobs.description: Return log probabilities of output tokens (same as chat_completion).

presence_penalty.description: Penalize tokens by whether they appeared already. Between -2 and 2.

reasoning_effort.description: Control reasoning depth for thinking models. Common values: `low`, `medium`, `high`.

response_format.description: Request structured output (same as chat_completion). `{ "type": "json_object" }` or `{ "type": "json_schema", "json_schema": {...} }`.

stop.description: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens.

subagent.description: Enable `openrouter:subagent` — delegate subtasks to a cheaper model.

top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens at each position (0–20). Requires `logprobs: true`.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling (alternative to temperature). Between 0 and 1.

web_blocked_domains.description: Block specific domains from web search results.

name: start_chat_completion
title: Start async chat completion
